inputs.text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued it burdened religious freedom by limiting access to abortion. The real story is how institutions can flip a principle on its head: a claim about protecting belief becomes a tool for weakening limits on abortion. The headline tells you which side LifeNews thinks is being served—but the carefully packaged legal language deserves scrutiny too.
